name: path-weighted interval bound on a sequential chain with engine choices
description: a and b each run for 2 on either engine, b after a, out (1) after b: the optimum is 5 whatever the engines. A min-max load relaxation proves only 2.5 (half of each step on each engine); the chain term proves the full 5. Charging a step on both engines would claim more than 5.
